_comment: Expected frontier depth bucket snapshots. Counts/names updated by running test with UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1. Manual curation after first run.

close._desc: Low expansionDistance (0-0.34). Artists very close to seed taste.

far._desc: Mid expansionDistance (0.34-0.67). Adjacent genres, moderate stretch.

farther._desc: High expansionDistance (0.67-1.0). Far from seed taste, bold picks.

all._desc: All frontier nodes. Sum of close+far+farther (or close+far+farther with minor overlap).
